CORRECTION: git status/diff after my first write revealed Test-TrailLink.ps1 already existed, tracked since commit 660b993 (fix: give pmcro-trail:initialize a real link-path script) -- predating this entire session. My initial write silently clobbered it (mode:rewrite was explicit, so the tool did not warn). Restored the file to HEAD via git checkout, then diffed and hand-tested the ORIGINAL against the 5 documented fixtures. All other logic (the disposition.trail_class-based class-a-unsupported check, the trail-linked/trail-sealed checks, comments) left exactly as originally authored.

Re-verified all 5 documented paths against the PATCHED script with real fixtures: bogus guid -> trail-not-found; sealed trail 4e2a7d63 -> trail-sealed; this trails own claimed cycle -> trail-linked; a fresh -OutputPath scratch trail referenced by -TrailPath ALONE (no -TrailId) -> now succeeds (this is the fix) returning the New-Trail.ps1-shaped result including task_id; a scratch trail with disposition.json hand-edited to trail_class A -> class-a-unsupported. All 5 fired correctly. Both scratch trail folders (under C:\Temp, never under .pmcro/trails/) deleted after use.
